extension.summary: Multi-Provider WireGuard VPN Manager (NordVPN, PIA, Custom)
extension.description: High-performance, hardened WireGuard VPN manager for LibreELEC. Now supports multiple providers including NordVPN (NordLynx), Private Internet Access (PIA), and Custom configurations. Features an automated Systemd watchdog to prevent connection drops.[CR][CR][B]Note:[/B] Designed specifically for LibreELEC. [CR][CR][B]Features:[/B][CR]• Multi-Provider Support (Nord, PIA, Custom)[CR]• Pure Python WireGuard Handshake logic[CR]• Smart Watchdog & Auto-Reconnect[CR]• Hardened DNS & IPv6 Leak Protection[CR][CR][B]Disclaimer:[/B] Not an official product of any VPN provider. Use at your own risk.
extension.news: v1.4.6 (2026-06-02) - Added visual indicators highlighting assigned configuration slots in yellow - Switched WireGuard endpoints to raw numeric IPs to fix LibreELEC 12 tunnels. - Hardcoded streaming-optimized DNS to fix geo-blocks on standard servers. - Added PIA API v3 Basic Auth support with automatic legacy v2 fallback. - Dropped unused, unpublished DNS server lookup arrays from config generator. - Added multi-line JSON stream parsing to prevent endpoint data format crashes. - Patched utf-8 codec and base64 regex credential crashes for plain-text logins. - Resolved ghost 'Temporary failure in name resolution' string memory errors. - Fixed a visual freeze bug by correcting progress dialog close animations. - Lowered background watchdog service CPU usage overhead and logging frequency.
